story.iWant: to practice typing with real quotes from various sources
story.soThat: I can improve my typing skills with engaging, meaningful content
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Quote Database and Content Management (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Create quotes database structure with metadata fields - Implement quote difficulty classification algorithm - Add initial seed data with diverse quotes - Ensure copyright compliance for quoted content
- Task 2: Quote Mode UI Components (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Create QuoteMode component extending TypingArea - Display quote metadata (author, source) prominently - Implement difficulty level selector - Style quote display with appropriate typography
- Task 3: Quote Generation and Loading Logic (AC: 1, 4) - Implement random quote selection algorithm - Create quote loading and display system - Handle edge cases (empty quotes, loading states) - Implement quote refresh functionality
- Task 4: Performance Tracking Integration (AC: 5, 6) - Store quote completion statistics in Firestore - Track performance metrics per quote difficulty - Implement quote-based performance analytics - Create quote completion history tracking
- Task 5: Testing and Quality Assurance (All ACs) - Unit tests for quote selection algorithms - Integration tests with existing typing engine - UI testing for quote mode components - Performance testing for quote loading

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Given I select Quote mode, when the mode loads then a random quote is displayed for typing practice 2. Given I select Quote mode, when the mode loads then quote metadata (author, source) is shown when available 3. Given I select Quote mode, when the mode loads then the quote length and difficulty are appropriate 4. Given I complete a quote, when I finish typing then a new quote automatically loads 5. Given I complete a quote, when I finish typing then my performance for the quote is recorded 6. Given I complete a quote, when I finish typing then I can choose quotes by difficulty level

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR-016: Generate random quotes for typing practice, FR-017: Support multiple languages (English, Vietnamese), FR-018: Vary quote length and difficulty, FR-019: Cite quote sources when available

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Component-based React architecture with feature-based organization, unidirectional data flow, and Firebase as backend-as-a-service

doc.title: Frontend Architecture
doc.snippet: Build custom components using Tailwind CSS for complete design control and consistency, lightweight approach with no additional component library overhead

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Implement diverse practice modes (Quote, Word, Character, Lesson, Code, Numbers) that provide varied typing experiences catering to different learning needs and skill levels

code.reason: Core typing component that provides character-by-character highlighting, input handling, and real-time feedback. Must be extended for Quote Mode.
Comprehensive typing engine with session management, metrics calculation, and timer functionality. Provides WPM, accuracy, and performance tracking integration.
Existing mode selection system that needs to be updated to include Quote mode option.
Performance metrics display component that will be used for showing quote completion statistics.
Results display pattern that quote metadata display should follow for consistency.
Firebase integration for storing quote data and user performance statistics.
Existing type system that will be extended with Quote-related types.
